\label {sol: forgetful functor from OrdVec to Vec has a left adjoint}We construct the left-adjoint using \Cref{exam: every vector space is a preordered vector space}; we let $F$ denote this to-be-constructed left-adjoint. This takes any real vector space and maps it to the pair of the vector space \& the trivial cone. In that case, every linear map ends up being monotone increasing map. This creates the required natural bijection between hom-sets, so we're done.
